 Getty Images Sport Hussein Hamdy 08 Nov 2026 05:05-05:00 Translated by Video: drama and premature celebration: Boca Juniors goal turns Rosario's joy into a nightmare
 Boca Juniors vs Defensa y Justicia Boca Juniors Defensa y Justicia Liga Profesional Rosario Central vs Estudiantes de Rio Cuarto Rosario Central Estudiantes de Rio Cuarto Argentina A celebratory scene suddenly turned upside down
 Boca Juniors are champions of Argentina. A dramatic 1-0 win over Defensa Justicia on Saturday night at La Bombonera, courtesy of Enner Valencia's stoppage-time goal, sealed top spot in the annual standings on the final round.
 The triumph comes just a year after the controversy that engulfed the same award, when Rosario Central were surprisingly declared champions.
 Valencia struck the winner in the 50th minute of the second half, lifting Boca to the summit of the overall table. They had amassed more points than anyone else across both the opening tournament, which covers the first half of the year, and the closing tournament in the second half.
 That second tournament is still running, with the knockout rounds under way to decide its champion.
 Rosario Central had already begun celebrating. Leading Estudiantes Río Cuarto 2-0, they watched their fans storm the pitch to join the players in the party.
 Then Boca struck. Valencia's goal deep into stoppage time flipped the whole picture, handing his side the win and the trophy, and ending a three-year wait to return to the winners' podium.
